verdict.rationale: The site has its own 'Statistiques et Données' section, which suggests the DGFiP publishes statistics and data directly, but the evidence is only a navigation label with no detail on downloadable formats or bulk extracts. 'Consulter un extrait de plan cadastral' is an individual plan lookup, not a bulk dataset, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: evidence of actual bulk downloadable datasets or files, machine-readable formats, registry or statistics extracts, update cadence and licensing, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
